result.instructions: Tools for WhatConverts, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many leads did we get last month, by type?"; "Show this week's phone call leads and where they came from."; "Which web form leads came in today and where did they come from?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WhatConverts data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run whatconverts_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run whatconverts_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run whatconverts_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. whatconverts_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: whatconverts_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List tracked leads (phone calls, web forms, chats, texts, emails, events, transactions) with source/medium/campaign/keyword attribution, contact details, quote and sales values, call duration and transcripts. start_date is REQUIRED because WhatConverts otherwise returns only today's leads; a range is at most 400 days. A Profile key sees its own profile; an Agency key can narrow by account_id/profile_id. GET /leads.

start_date.description: First day/time to include (UTC), e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

end_date.description: Last day/time to include (UTC). Range from start_date at most 400 days.

quotable.description: Only leads with this quotable state.

quote_value.description: Only leads with / without a quote value.

sales_value.description: Only leads with / without a sales value.

user_id.description: Only leads handled by this WhatConverts user id.

account_id.description: Agency key only: only this account (see whatconverts_list_accounts).

profile_id.description: Agency key only: only this profile.

order.description: Sort by date created: asc or desc (default desc).

customer_journey.description: Include customer journey data (Elite plans only).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: whatconverts_get_lead
tools.title: Get lead
tools.description: One lead by id with every field: type, status, attribution (source, medium, campaign, keyword, landing page), contact details, location, device, quote/sales value, call details, transcripts, form/message content, and custom fields. GET /leads/{lead_id}.

customer_journey.description: Include the customer journey (Elite plans only).

tools.name: whatconverts_get_call_recording_info
tools.title: Get call recording info
tools.description: Recording and voicemail facts for a phone-call lead: the recording and voicemail links, call duration, answer status, tracking/caller numbers and the call/voicemail transcripts. Returns links and text only, never audio. Taken from GET /leads/{lead_id} (the audio endpoint GET /recording returns raw MP3 and is not used).

lead_id.description: WhatConverts lead id of a phone call.

tools.name: whatconverts_update_lead
tools.title: Update lead
tools.description: WRITE: update a lead's sales data in WhatConverts: quotable state, quote value, sales value, the URL where the lead occurred, and/or custom/additional field values. Only the fields you pass change; it overwrites the previous values of those fields. Sends no notifications. At least one field is required. POST /leads/{lead_id}.

additional_fields.description: Additional field values by field name, e.g. {"Reason": "pricing"}.

custom_fields.description: Custom lead field values by field name.

tools.name: whatconverts_create_lead
tools.title: Create lead
tools.description: WRITE: add a lead to WhatConverts, for example an offline phone call, a form submission from another system or a sale you want attributed. It appears in reports and counts toward lead totals; send_notification is always off, so no emails go out. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two leads. A Profile key adds to its own profile; an Agency key must pass profile_id. POST /leads.

profile_id.description: Profile to add the lead to (required with an Agency key, not with a Profile key).

date_created.description: When the lead happened (UTC); default now.

email_address.description: Contact email address (stored on the lead; nothing is sent to it).

tools.name: whatconverts_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: Agency key only: list the accounts (clients) of the agency with their profiles (id, name, date created). Use the ids to filter leads. start_date/end_date filter by creation date (WhatConverts defaults start_date to today, so pass an early start_date to see all). GET /accounts.

start_date.description: Accounts created from this date (UTC). Pass 2014-11-11 (the earliest date WhatConverts accepts) to list all.

end_date.description: Accounts created up to this date (UTC).

order.description: Sort by date created: asc or desc (default desc).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: whatconverts_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Agency key only: one account by id with its profiles. GET /accounts/{account_id}.

tools.name: whatconverts_list_profiles
tools.title: List profiles
tools.description: Agency key only: list the profiles (websites/campaign sets) of one account. start_date/end_date filter by creation date (WhatConverts defaults start_date to today, so pass an early start_date to see all). GET /accounts/{account_id}/profiles.

start_date.description: Profiles created from this date (UTC). Pass 2014-11-11 (the earliest date WhatConverts accepts) to list all.

end_date.description: Profiles created up to this date (UTC).

order.description: Sort by date created: asc or desc (default desc).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: whatconverts_get_profile
tools.title: Get profile
tools.description: Agency key only: one profile by id (name, date created). GET /accounts/{account_id}/profiles/{profile_id}.

tools.name: whatconverts_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: Agency key only: list WhatConverts users (email, role, whether activation is pending) of the master account or of client accounts. start_date/end_date filter by creation date (WhatConverts defaults start_date to today, so pass an early start_date to see all). GET /users.

start_date.description: Users created from this date (UTC). Pass 2014-11-11 (the earliest date WhatConverts accepts) to list all.

end_date.description: Users created up to this date (UTC).

order.description: Sort by date created: asc or desc (default desc).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: whatconverts_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Agency key only: one user by id with role, notification settings and (for account users) the accounts they can access. GET /users/{user_id}.

tools.name: whatconverts_list_roles
tools.title: List roles
tools.description: Agency key only: list user roles (id, name, master-account or account type). GET /roles.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: whatconverts_get_role
tools.title: Get role
tools.description: Agency key only: one role with its permission levels (none/view/edit) per area. GET /roles/{role_id}.

tools.name: whatconverts_list_phone_numbers
tools.title: List tracking phone numbers
tools.description: List the call-tracking numbers: tracking and destination number, call flow, trigger (source/medium), call recording and messaging flags, last used. A Profile key lists its own profile; an Agency key may filter by account_id/profile_id. GET /tracking/numbers.

account_id.description: Agency key only: only this account.

profile_id.description: Agency key only: only this profile.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: whatconverts_list_web_forms
tools.title: List tracked web forms
tools.description: List the web forms WhatConverts tracks (id, name, how the form and its submit are matched on the page). A Profile key lists its own profile; an Agency key may filter by account_id/profile_id. GET /tracking/forms.

account_id.description: Agency key only: only this account.

profile_id.description: Agency key only: only this profile.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.
